sections.Profile:
"Hairy Singers" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in 1966. Designed for single-player gameplay, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and a passive bumper.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Prehistoric, Singing, Original Theme
